pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Test Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Have you recently moved to an English speaking country or do you plan to do so in the near future? Or, are you job hunting for a position with an international company? If either of these apply to you, you have probably already head of the  International English Language Testing System (IELTS). It is one of the most common tests required for English learners/speakers who need to transition into workplaces and educational institutions where English is the primary language for communication. It consists of four sections, reading, writing, listening, and speaking. So, let's cut to the chase--is it difficult? 

No. Is it common for English speakers to score low without preparation? Absolutely. Preparation is all about having a strong familiarity with the strategies required to perform well in each section of the test. Attempting to memorize the tasks and responses that you have seen in practice tests online will not help you to get the score you need. In my IELTS preparation lessons, we practice highly effective strategies related to:
⏳ Timing
📖 Purposeful Reading
🔎 Text Scanning
🗣️ Vocabulary Extension
💭 Response Anticipation
and many more!

Every student's needs are a bit different and what is considered a 'pass' or 'fail' depends on what you need to take the test for. The highest band of scores on the IELTS is a 9. Some students require a minimum score of 4 in all sections, others a 7.5, for example. The strategies that I teach in my lessons are essential for all students' goals. I have helped several students in the industries of technology, agriculture, education, retail, and software development, to get the scores they need on the IELTS. I can help you, too. 

Let's determine your goal(s), discuss your strengths and starting point, and make a plan that will help you get the score you need on the IELTS confidently!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Work or Business
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how to have a conversation about your work or business at a meeting, a conference, a cocktail party or a business lunch. You will learn and practice how to: 
1. Say what your work or business is, 
2. Ask about other people's work or business, establish rapport
3. Explain why you are at this meeting/conference/event/dinner
4. Ask questions that you want to ask
5. Understand the answers that you get
You will receive some materials that you can use to review your lesson later, learn and practice more.

pro_course_detail.title: Test Preparation /  English for Academic Purposes
pro_course_detail.description: Learn how to talk and write about your field of study or research interests at an advanced level. Prepare for study in the medium of English: understand the academic culture and expectations in the higher education environment in the English-speaking countries; focus on academic writing, speaking, presentations or discussion.

pro_course_detail.description: These lessons will help you to speak more clearly and eliminate some of the most significant obstacles for fluent communication in English.

pro_course_detail.title: General English: Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing plus Grammar and Vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description: I will work with you to take your English to the next level. You will develop all 4 language skills, plus vocabulary and grammar, in a practical, communicative approach. You will learn to use English vocabulary and grammar to express your own ideas and thoughts, participate in conversations or write in English. I will help you develop strategies to improve your listening and reading, so that you can enjoy videos, audios, written texts and find information you need in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation and Resume Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for a job interview? Not sure how to answer tricky interview questions? Concerned about your grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation? 
We will discuss your resume / CV and polish it to bring forward the best in your experience, skills and education, and make it look professional and convincing. We will also design the best strategies for each of your difficult potential interview questions. You will practice your answers while I will give you detailed feedback and advise how you can do it better.  If the selection process requires you to write any texts, I will help you develop ideas, draft and edit your documents. 
I have helped people working in business, academia, government and international organisations  achieve their goals, and I am looking forward to helping you, too.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation with a native English speaker
pro_course_detail.description:

During our conversation, I note down any mistakes that the student makes such as pronunciation, grammar, intonation etc and we'll go through them together.

Towards the end of the lesson, I'll give you a set of vocabulary used from the lesson with the definition. For homework (which is optional) you use the vocabulary and create sentences or discussion questions and I'll check it the next lesson. 

For more advanced students I can also incorporate phrasal verbs and idioms in the discussion.

During your lesson I'll check your homework and we'll discuss the TED Talk. This is a good listening and speaking practice based on something you've watched and you put your listening skills into practice by discussing what you've heard with the teacher. 

This course is suited for students who have a good level of English and is diligent to do their homework.
